feeds.title: Game From Scratch
feeds.description: Game From Scratch blog covers all things game development related, with a focus on gaming news, tutorials, Game engines, art tools, and programming languages. After doing text-based tutorials for several years, they have started slowly making more video content.

feeds.title: Prima Games
feeds.description: Founded in 2015, PC Invasion celebrates the personal computer as one of the most widely used, cutting-edge, and versatile gaming platforms in the world. We're dedicated to the inclusiveness of PC gaming, which includes technology enthusiasts, more casual players, and esports fans.

feeds.title: GameKnight Games and Cool Stuff Blog
feeds.description: GameKnight Games is the premier game store in Winnipeg, with thousands of different board games, card games, dice games, roleplaying games, miniature games, and plenty of other cool stuff. Keep up to date with new stock, new events, new sales, and everything else new.

feeds.title: Toronto Sun » Gaming
feeds.description: Read the latest gaming news, video game reviews & rumors updates in Toronto Sun, an English-language tabloid newspaper published daily in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Toronto Sun offers information on the latest national and international events, entertainment, politics, sports & more.

feeds.title: 4Scarrs Gaming
feeds.description: For all the latest gaming news and reviews including PS5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, Amazon Luna, Atari VCS, and Intellivision Amico, check out the 4Scarrs Gaming posts. This website will keep you up with all new gaming content.

feeds.title: MobileSyrup » Gaming
feeds.description: MobileSyrup is all about making gaming tech content for everyone. Based in Canada, we're a blog/news website that covers all kinds of tech-related content.

feeds.title: Video Chums
feeds.description: Video Chums brings you great video game content including fair and unbiased reviews and interesting articles for new and retro video games. Read our insightful articles about video games for unique perspectives and valuable information on all things gaming.

feeds.title: CGMagazine » Game Reviews
feeds.description: CGMagazine is a convergence of culture and media, looking at gaming, film, tabletop, and technology. With features, reviews, articles, and news, CGM is here to keep you informed and in the know on everything new and exciting in games.

feeds.title: Ratloop Games Canada » Dev Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is packed with articles about game development and our current project. Ratloop Games Canada is an independent Montreal-based studio currently developing the turn-based FPS Lemnis Gate for PC, Xbox, and PlayStation.

feeds.title: Femme Gaming Blog
feeds.description: Femme Gaming Blog is a vibrant online space dedicated to celebrating and empowering female gamers. Founded by a passionate group of gaming enthusiasts, the blog offers a diverse range of content, including game reviews, industry news, and discussions on inclusivity in gaming. Immerse yourself in the world of gaming through the unique perspective of female gamers, discover new game recommendations, and join a supportive community of fellow gamers.

feeds.title: Canadian Game Devs Blog
feeds.description: News involving the video games developed in Canada, and the people who make them. Indie Games, AAA Games, and in between featured and reported on.

feeds.title: LF Gaming Blog
feeds.description: LF Gaming is a family-owned and operated company that builds extremely comfortable & ergonomic gaming chairs for alleviating pain and preventing further injury to your body. Get to know everything about gaming chairs on LF Gaming Blog.

feeds.title: Must Contain Minis Blog
feeds.description: Must Contain Minis is a website and blog dedicated to miniature wargames and boardgames containing miniatures.
